task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Perform single-qubit state tomography in Qiskit by hand: prepare RY(0.728) RZ(1.017)|0>, measure X, Y, Z expectation values with StatevectorEstimator, reconstruct the density matrix rho = (I + <X>X + <Y>Y + <Z>Z)/2, and report fidelity with the true state. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
